newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian UCB sells fine chemicals unit.
newsitem.headline: Belgian UCB sells fine chemicals unit.

text.p: Belgian chemicals company UCB said on Tuesday it had sold its UCB Fine Chemicals subsidiary to Belgium's Proviron NV for undisclosed terms.
UCB said in a statement it expected to book a capital gain of around 400 million Belgian francs on the transaction.
UCB Fine Chemicals makes additives used in plastics manufacturing. In 1995 it had sales of around 1.1 billion Belgian francs and was the smallest of UCB's five chemicals business units, UCB said.
UCB said Proviron was financing the acquisition through an alliance with VIV, a subsidiary of bank Generale de Banque SA, which is taking a stake in the capital.
